summary: The filing reports that Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco entered into a debt-to-equity conversion agreement with an affiliate of its chairman, exchanging $4M of debt for 1,612,903 shares of Class A common stock at $2.48 per share (VWAP-based). The shares are subject to a lock-up until December 31, 2026. This is a routine capital structure cleanup, not a transformative special situation. No tender, spin-off, restructuring, or strategic review is announced. The transaction is non-dilutive in a strategic sense and reflects ordinary-course liability management, not a control event or activist campaign.
